hints.title: Leftward Value Shift Constraint
hints.text: Values can only flow to the left. No value from nums[0..i] can ever cross to the right of index i.

hints.title: Prefix Ceiling Average
hints.text: For any prefix nums[0..i], the sum must be distributed among the first i + 1 positions, which imposes a lower bound of ceil(sum(nums[0..i]) / (i + 1)).

hints.title: Global Maximum of Prefix Averages
hints.text: Because numbers can always be shifted leftward to smooth out spikes, the optimal minimum maximum equals the maximum prefix ceiling average across all indices.

hints.title: Prefix Average Lower Bound Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass tracking prefix sum and running maximum average.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating transfer operations step-by-step is computationally intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory operates directly on running cumulative sum.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that leftward shifts bound the result by the prefix averages.
